solo.question: You work alone. What happens if you're unavailable?

agentVsAutomation.question: What's the difference between an AI agent and an automation?
agentVsAutomation.answer: An automation follows fixed rules: when an email arrives, it adds a row to the CRM. An AI agent reads, decides and acts within limits you set, for example sorting a customer request and drafting a reply. Many projects use both.

tools.question: n8n, Make or custom code?
tools.answer: It depends on the process and on who will maintain it. n8n or Make work well when your team wants to change the steps itself. Custom code makes sense when you need fine-grained control, tests or high volume.

nothingFound.question: What if the audit finds nothing useful?
nothingFound.answer: You keep the process map and the roadmap, even if you go no further.

bpifrance.question: Is this audit a Bpifrance Diag Data IA?

data.answer: Your accounts and tools stay in your name, and I map the data before writing any code. definition.title: What is a Forward Deployed Engineer?
definition.body: A Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is a developer who works directly with a customer's team, on their codebase, to get a product into production. The role comes from software companies like Palantir, and AI labs now use it to deploy their models with customers. As a freelancer I do the same work on a fractional basis: I join your team a few days a week, without you making a full-time hire.

audience.title: Who it's for
audience.body: A 2 to 4 person startup that has to ship an AI feature before its next round and has no time to hire. Or an agency that signed an AI project and has nobody to build it.

vsFreelance.answer: A freelancer usually delivers a project defined up front. As an FDE I work inside your team on whatever matters most right now, join your stand-ups and ship every week.

minimum.question: Why 4 weeks minimum?
minimum.answer: It takes one to two weeks to really learn your codebase and your team. Below four weeks, you'd mostly be paying for that ramp-up.

days.question: Can we go above 3 days a week?
days.answer: No. Three days a week is my maximum per client, so every engagement gets the same quality of work.

remote.question: Do you work on site?

vsSprint.question: FDE or AI Sprint?
vsSprint.answer: The AI Sprint delivers one defined workflow at a fixed price in two weeks. The FDE fits when your backlog keeps changing and you need someone inside the team for several weeks.

sprintVsFde.question: Why does an AI Sprint cost less than 10 FDE days?
sprintVsFde.answer: The AI Sprint is sold on the outcome: one workflow, with a scope I fix before work starts.
